newsitem.title: LEBANON: LEBANON T-BILL AUCTION RAISES 319.5 BLN POUNDS.
newsitem.headline: LEBANON T-BILL AUCTION RAISES 319.5 BLN POUNDS.

text.p: Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of August 7 raised 319.5 billion Lebanese pounds, according to finance ministry results issued on Monday.
The previous issue raised 320.9 billion pounds.
The issue posted a nominal surplus of subscription against maturity of five billion pounds. The three previous issues had posted deficits.
The August 7 issue raised the following amounts (in billion of pounds, previous week in brackets):

The central bank accepted 50 percent of all competitive bids -- those made by Lebanese institutions -- and non-competitive bids -- those made by private individuals and foreign investors -- up to the discount rate and yield for three-month bills.
All competitive and non-competitive bids were approved for six-month, one-year and two-year bills.
The Lebanese pound closed at 1,536.75 to the U.S. dollar on Monday from 1,537.25 a week earlier and 1,565 a year ago.
